posts.headline: Fact
posts.body:
Sleep is when your brain clears toxic waste through the glymphatic system.
Skipping sleep lets toxins build up in your brain.
posts.cta: Sleep is your brain's detox cycle.

posts.headline: Statistic
posts.body:
Men who drink 5+ cups of coffee per day have a 59% lower risk of lethal prostate cancer.
Caffeine appears to slow cancer cell growth.
posts.cta: Coffee is good for your prostate.
